sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Ops Phone at 6% at shift start; standing by at HQ to recharge while awaiting response calls.
Commencing Alpha Route; leaving standby at HQ with the Ops Phone at 35%.
Welfare check at Starbucks, all clear. Patrolling up Queen Street ensuring a strong security presence.
Welfare check at Localito Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street, 77 Convenience Store and Mid City Shopping Centre, all clear. Maintaining presence in the area before moving along.
Continuing patrols and making our way to the next checkpoint.
Welfare check at Remedy Coffee, all clear.
Check-in at Aotea Square; full scope of the location, no issues present. Standing by to show presence while awaiting further response calls.
Check-in at the top of Victoria Street West; welfare check on all stores within the area. A few street vagrants visible but no issues identified. Standing by to show presence before moving along.
Continuing patrols and making our presence known along Albert Street.
Welfare check at Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy, all clear.
Check-in at the corner of Customs and Albert Street intersection; area checked, all clear.
Welfare check at Metro Woolworths and Aotea Gifts, all clear.
Check-in at Commercial Bay; full walkthrough completed and the location thoroughly scoped for any concerns, all clear.
Standing by to ensure a strong security presence while awaiting further response calls.
Response call from 75 Victoria Street regarding a group of street vagrants congregating within the area; assistance requested to ask them to move along.
Arrived at the response location; the group of street vagrants was no longer present. Standing by to show presence while awaiting further response calls.
Arrived at HQ; took the timesheets up to Level 7 and took a restroom break while remaining available for response calls.
Leaving standby and commencing patrols; ensuring a strong security presence on Queen Street with welfare checks on all stores and businesses.
Response call from Amelia Cafe regarding a female street vagrant sitting on their customer-only benches; she had refused staff requests to move along.
Arrived at the response call; the female had already moved along and was sitting to the side of the store. Standing by to show presence before continuing. (Photo on file.)
Arrived at Elliott Street; standing by to ensure our presence is known.
Arrived at HQ for the morning interval. Ending Alpha Route.
Break concluded; standing by to recharge the Ops Phone (13%) before moving along.
Leaving standby with the Ops Phone at 35%; commencing Delta Route. Patrolling through Queen Street ensuring our presence is visible.
Welfare check along Fort Lane and Fort Street; checked in with the static guards and stores, all clear.
Check-in at the bottom of Fort Street; checked in on stores and businesses, all clear.
Check-in at Kiwi Bank; welfare check completed on all stores within the area, all clear.
Check-in at Commercial Bay; full sweep completed with welfare checks on stores and static guards, all clear. Standing by to show presence before moving along.
Patrolling up Queen Street ensuring our presence is strongly visible.
Check-in at Aotea Square; full sweep of the area, heavy presence from members of the public. Standing by to show presence while awaiting further response calls.
Continuing patrols and making our way to the next checkpoint; no issues observed while stationed at Aotea Square.
Welfare check at Auckland Library, all clear.
Check-in at the corner of Lorne and Wellesley Street, all clear. Commencing welfare checks on all stores and businesses within Lorne Street.
Arrived back at HQ; taking lunch break and preparing for changeover to the Afternoon Shift while remaining available for response calls.
Morning Shift completed; equipment handed over.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radio, 2 x Bodycam, 1 x Swipe Key.
Response call from V-Phix Mobiles at the top of Victoria Street regarding a male individual who thrashed products in-store and left; assistance requested.
Arrived at the response call and spoke to the individual in-store; he willingly agreed to pay for his phone to be fixed. No store items were damaged.
The individual calmed down, paid for the damaged phone and left the premises.
Heading back to HQ Level 7 at management's request.
Finished meeting with management on Level 7.
Commencing Alpha Route; check-in at the corner of Victoria Street East and Queen Street, all clear.
Standing by in front of Footlocker to show presence in the middle of Queen Street.
Commencing welfare checks towards Aotea Square to show presence, as this area is high priority for the Afternoon Shift. Welfare check, all clear:
Check-in at Skyworld Entertainment Centre and Aotea Square, all clear.
Standing by at Aotea Square to show presence to the family-friendly activities ongoing in the square (15:30–15:45).
Standing by at the corner of The Terrace and Cafe & Bar (15:45–16:00).
Conducting a welfare check and walkthrough of the Bledisloe Building alleyway behind Skyworld Entertainment Centre.
Standing by at the corner of Elliott Street and Wellesley Street West intersection.
Welfare check on stores within the vicinity, all clear:
Standing by at Elliott Stables, corner of Elliott Street and Wellesley Street West, to show presence (16:15–16:30).
Leaving standby and commencing welfare checks along the left-hand side of the street strip towards Commercial Bay.
Welfare check at Mecca, Dangerfield, Lush, NZ Muscle and 2degrees, all clear.
Crossed the road; welfare check at Farmers, Peter Alexander, Lotus Foreign Exchange, Vans, Noel Leeming, W Cosmetics and Glassons, all clear.

Standing by at the corner of the Durham Street East alleyway and Queen Street to show presence; heavy foot traffic in the area and a well-balanced position for response calls to either upper or lower Queen Street (16:45–17:00).
Leaving standby; heading back to HQ to charge the Ops Phone.
Arrived back at HQ to charge the Ops Phone (5%); percentage displayed on camera.
Mandatory building sweep and welfare check completed; heading back out on routes.
Commencing Alpha Route towards Commercial Bay.
Welfare check on both sides of the road towards Commercial Bay, all clear:
Standing by at the corner of Wyndham Street and Queen Street to show presence.
Leaving standby area and commencing patrols.
Welfare check through businesses on Vulcan Lane, all clear.
Welfare check at Kathmandu, Macpac, Art Gallery and Faradays, all clear.
Standing by at the corner of Shortland Street and Queen Street.
Response call from Quest on Queen Street regarding a suspicious male individual standing outside the premises who had been inside earlier; staff requested we have a word with him.
Arrived at the response call; spotted the individual and spoke to him about being inside the premises without having a room. The male, wearing a mask and glasses, left the area.
Standing by to show presence in case the individual decides to come back inside the premises; the receptionist is locking up for the day.
Preparing to leave standby to attend a response call from Cotton On.
Arrived at the response call; the individual had moved along.
Tracked the female down to McDonald's Queen Street together with management (Hasi).
Approached and spoke to the female individual; she became defensive and appears to be under the influence of narcotics.
Standing by with management on Queen Street.
Leaving standby and recommencing Alpha Route.
Welfare check at New World, Unichem Pharmacy, PB Tech, Westpac and Souvenirs, all clear.
Welfare check at Western Union Money Exchange, Q Convenience Store, Night Car and Luxury Karaoke, all clear.
Check-in at Commercial Bay; full sweep around the area, all in order.
Ending Alpha Route and commencing Beta Route.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart and Movenpick Hotel, all clear.
Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store, corner of Commerce Street and Customs Street West, all clear.
Welfare check at Giapo Gore Street and Auckland Harbour Suites, all clear.
Welfare check at Smiley Mart Convenience Store and Tribe, all clear.
Heading to HQ to charge the Ops Phone due to low battery percentage.
Arrived back at HQ; standing by and charging the Ops Phone. Percentage displayed on camera.
Ops Phone at 33%; recommencing Beta Route. Noted that power banks would allow patrols without interruptions for charging the Ops Phone.
Most stores are now closed for trading hours apart from a few open for late hours.
Check-in at Chancery Square and Freyberg Square, all clear.
Welfare check at SQ Bar, O Bar, Caravan Serrai, Bistro Chancery, Circle K and Almightyodog, all clear.
Welfare check on stores along High Street: Chubby Boy, Dong De Moon, Machi Machi and Dilruba Shisha Lounge, all clear.
Welfare check through stores on Lorne Street.
Welfare check at BBQ Duck Cafe, BBQ Grill Planet, Meet Fresh, Uncle Mann, Red Radisson and Chill Saigon, all clear.
Standing by at the Lorne Street fountain.
Check-in at the corner of Rutland Street and Wakefield Street, all clear.
Check-in at Skyworld Entertainment Centre, all clear.
Ending Beta Route; standing by in the middle of Queen Street to show presence.
Lunch break completed; standing by for changeover to the Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Responded to a call from McDonald's Britomart requesting an individual be moved along.
Arrived on site and asked the individual to move along.
The individual left the premises; no further issues.
Incident outside the Adidas store; stood by to provide any assistance. One individual was released and one was taken in by Police; no further issues.
Commercial Bay all clear, no issues. Patrolling Quay Street.
Welfare check at Danny's; on standby showing presence.
Danny's all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check at Albert Street Convenience Store, no issues to report.
Check-in at St Patrick's Cathedral Church, all clear, no issues to report.
On standby at Ace Karaoke showing presence.
Continuing standby at Ace Karaoke due to the crowd inside the bar; the venue is busy at this time (01:10–01:50).
Ace Karaoke all clear, no issues.
Patrolling Federal Street; welfare check at 77 Convenience Store, no issues at this time, but vagrants hanging around outside. On standby showing presence.
77 Convenience Store all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep of Federal Street complete, all clear, no issues to report.
Wellesley Street all clear, no issues.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street, all clear, no issues; on standby showing presence.
McDonald's Queen Street all clear, no issues to report. Commencing a full sweep of upper Queen Street.
Upper Queen Street full sweep complete, no issues to report.
Patrolling Aotea Square; commencing a full sweep.
Aotea Square all clear, no issues to report. On standby for any nearby calls.
Aotea Square all clear, no issues to report and no nearby calls. Heading back to HQ for a 30-minute break.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street, all clear, no issues to report.
Observed an individual acting suspiciously outside Footlocker; on approaching, it became clear she was talking to her own reflection. No further issues; heading to HQ.
Responded to a call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding an individual causing issues for staff.
The individual went and bought food in order to remain inside; on standby for further notice from staff.
No further issues; heading back to HQ for changeover.
